evidence_gaps: Fresh-within-two-hours sanitized runtime forensics are absent; evidence.json reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
Before any promotion: immutable per-attempt quotes, simulations, submission timestamps, receipts/signatures, fills, wallet deltas and failed-attempt costs.

Before any promotion: realized money-weighted net P&L by strategy and chain after DEX/protocol fees, slippage, price impact, gas or Solana priority fees, builder payments, account costs and execution failures.
Before any promotion: explicit attribution of each loss to STRATEGY/MARKET or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE, with reason codes and reconciliation totals.
Before any promotion: chronological out-of-sample results across congestion, volatility and liquidity regimes, including drawdown, concentration and confidence bounds.
Before any Solana promotion: contemporaneous size-specific entry/exit quotes, sell simulations, compute/priority fees, rent-versus-refundable-deposit accounting and quote-to-fill drift.
Before any EVM promotion: realized gas on successful and reverted transactions, EIP-1559 priority costs, builder payments, nonce/replacement failures and quote-to-fill drift.
No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness claim is supported by the supplied architecture-only evidence.

proposals.downside_risk: More conservative accounting will reduce apparent edge and delay promotion; classification rules may initially require manual validation.

evidence.detail: Window accounting records fees and slippage but has no explicit price-impact, latency/adverse-selection, gas/priority-fee, failed-attempt cost, or failure-class fields; default net is gross profit minus gross loss, fees and slippage.

Promotion-candidate logic can pass after only three windows and eight trades when aggregate net and profit factor exceed fixed thresholds, without chain, regime, capital-weighting, or out-of-sample requirements.
Execution failures are counted separately, but their incurred gas or priority costs are not incorporated into net P&L by this state model.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents promotion based on understated costs and makes strategy rework distinguishable from infrastructure repair.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 completed exits and 100 execution attempts per chain, spanning at least 14 days and multiple congestion/volatility regimes; report money-weighted net P&L and failure costs separately by chain and strategy.
proposals.rationale: Durable money-weighted performance requires complete all-in economic accounting. Market movement after a valid fill is a STRATEGY/MARKET outcome; reverts, RPC faults, stale-blockhash expiry, quote-to-fill degradation and missing confirmations are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE outcomes. Both can lose capital, but they require different remediation.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay future SHADOW observations with immutable per-attempt ledgers. For EVM include realized gas on successes and reverts, priority fees, builder payments, DEX fees, price impact and quote-to-fill drift. For Solana include base and priority fees, non-refundable account costs, rent separately from refundable deposits, Jupiter price impact, failed-signature fees and quote-to-fill drift. Stop and mark the accounting model failed if ledger reconstruction differs from wallet/receipt deltas beyond a predefined dust tolerance or if any failure cannot be assigned STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE.
proposals.strategy: Strategy Lab evaluation and lifecycle governance

proposals.downside_risk: Extra quote traffic may encounter rate limits, and conservative round-trip tests may reject genuine directional opportunities.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events intentionally receive zero gross edge, liquidity, sellability and cost features and are labeled SIGNAL_ONLY_MISSING_CURRENT_EXECUTABLE_EDGE.
Shadow entry validation obtains round-trip Jupiter quotes, but P&L uses fixed estimated entry and exit fees rather than observed congestion-sensitive priority and execution costs.
Live execution simulates and captures wallet snapshots, providing an architectural basis for reconciliation, but current review evidence contains no fresh results.

proposals.expected_effect: Allows Solana hypotheses to abstain unless a contemporaneous, size-specific, round-trip executable edge remains positive after conservative costs.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 eligible leader events, 50 simulated round trips and 30 independently closed SHADOW positions across at least 14 days, with results stratified by liquidity, latency, congestion and position size.
proposals.rationale: A copied leader's historical success is not executable edge for a delayed follower. Solana economics require current round-trip sellability, price impact, route freshness, priority fees, account creation/rent treatment and failed-transaction costs.
proposals.shadow_test: For each leader BUY, record timestamped size-matched entry and immediate exit quotes, price impact, route, simulated compute/priority fee, account/rent effects and signal latency; then mark to an independently timestamped executable exit quote. Reject the hypothesis if money-weighted net P&L after all costs is non-positive, sell simulation fails, quote freshness exceeds the configured bound, or EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure cost consumes the modeled edge.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer observation periods and stricter uncertainty bounds may leave strategies dormant during sparse markets.

evidence.detail: Quote/simulation events are correctly marked promotion_evidence=0 and documented as insufficient for LIVE promotion.
Common rules require positive modeled net edge, liquidity, sellability and fresh quotes, but fixed basis-point thresholds are shared after adapter-supplied cost estimates.
Aggregate evaluation does not require chronological holdout performance, lower-confidence-bound profitability, drawdown limits, or per-chain positive net results.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces false promotion by requiring durable, independently observed, chain-specific money-weighted edge.
proposals.minimum_observation: A parameter-frozen holdout of at least 30 completed trades per applicable chain, at least 14 days, three market regimes, and at least 100 execution attempts including failures.
proposals.rationale: In-sample aggregate profit can hide regime dependence, EVM gas sensitivity, Solana congestion sensitivity, capital concentration and one-chain losses subsidized by another.
proposals.shadow_test: Freeze parameters before a chronological holdout. Evaluate each chain separately using realized or independently marked executable outcomes, including every failed-attempt cost. Require positive money-weighted net P&L and profit factor above 1 after costs in the holdout, with no single trade contributing more than 25% of total profit. Stop on non-positive holdout net, material cost-accounting gaps, or a lower confidence bound at or below zero.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote a strategy from the current quote/simulation scorecard.
rejected_ideas.reason: The repository explicitly marks these observations as non-realized and non-promotion evidence, and fresh runtime forensics are unavailable.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency or relax edge, liquidity, sellability, simulation, or quote-freshness gates.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades do not imply greater money-weighted net P&L and could amplify price impact, failed-execution costs and adverse selection.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat Solana leader win rate as current follower edge.
rejected_ideas.reason: Follower latency, size-specific impact, sellability, priority fees and account costs are not established by leader history.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM performance into one promotion result.
rejected_ideas.reason: Their fee markets, failure modes, settlement mechanics and liquidity economics differ; aggregation can conceal a loss-making chain.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally fails closed, requires positive modeled edge, and keeps quote simulations separate from promotion evidence. However, Strategy Lab accounting does not fully represent chain-specific all-in costs or explicitly attribute STRATEGY/MARKET losses versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. Solana research also lacks contemporaneous executable-edge features. No profitability, CANARY-readiness, or LIVE-readiness conclusion is possible without fresh runtime forensics.
